name: PeoplePay-360 / PayProof
summary: Proof-carrying commission dispute resolution. For a sales rep's pay dispute it reconciles HRIS, CRM, contracts, billing, comp plan and payroll records. It computes what should have been paid with deterministic decimal code, has a skeptic try to falsify the explanation, replays counterfactuals, and proposes one approval-gated action that executes at most once on a simulated payroll adapter and is verified afterwards. Missing or contradictory evidence means it abstains.
track: Track 02 — The Agent That Can Explain Why
data: synthetic only (30 hand-labelled dispute cases, 5 of them adversarial, plus a 30-text security corpus); no real people, money or payroll systems

agents.role: assembles evidence, proposes the initial explanation and the reconciliation waterfall
Meterless Scout Intent: injection check on every retrieved record and on intake text; quarantined records never reach the model and escalate the action to controller approval
tests evidence that would falsify the explanation, linked to counterfactual replays
agents.model: code; optional Nemotron phrasing of the strongest counterargument

agents.role: recomputes every amount from cited records, checks invariants, conflict materiality and the World Model as-of-cutoff cross-check
proposes one typed action with permission, preconditions and idempotency key
drops claims citing unknown records or amounts the engine did not compute; blocks unsafe actions
backend authorization, approval limits, segregation of duties, stale-evidence gate, simulated execution, postcondition re-investigation, hash-chained audit
Meterless H-MEM: stores only human-approved, postcondition-verified outcomes; recalls precedents from other cases for the reviewer; never feeds the calculation

where.World Model: payproof/world_model.py — Python implementation of the Meterless World Model reference (stable ids, merge banding, provenance-required writes, bitemporal edges, idempotent ingest, ordered audit)
where.H-MEM: payproof/hmem.py — Python port of the official H-MEM reference (hybrid retrieval formula, trust ledger, feedback deltas, conflict gate, sleep guardrails, dreaming approval boundary) plus PayProof's PrecedentMemory
where.Scout Intent: payproof/scout.py — PayProof implementation of the Scout Intent spec (intent registry, injection / RBAC / PII guard, capability scope, HMAC-signed execution contracts with a 5-minute TTL); the spec publishes no reference code

used_for: evidence intake: every investigation ingests the case's source records with provenance (source system, recorded time) and typed bitemporal relationships (validFrom = effective time)
verifier cross-check: the World Model's as-of-cutoff graph view must contain exactly the cash events the policy engine counted
model context builder: the Nemotron prompt is built from the World Model neighbourhood of the disputed opportunity
stale-evidence gate: actions snapshot the World Model at proposal; approval and execution re-ingest and expire the action if ingest reports changed=true
judge evidence: World Model audit written as JSONL to logs/ and samples/logs/

H-MEM verified-precedent memory: only an approved action whose postcondition passed becomes a precedent (refs: case, action, receipt, proof hash); investigations recall precedents from other cases only, shown to the reviewer with a consistency check
Scout execution contracts: the action service refuses to propose, approve or execute without a valid, unexpired contract whose capabilities cover the operation

Scout guard: injection text in user intake is refused (422); injection text in retrieved source records is quarantined, kept out of the model context, raised as a security finding and escalates the action to controller approval
meterless.verification: World Model: tests/test_world_model.py is a one-to-one Python port of the official 8-check conformance suite (engines/world-model/conformance/runner.ts) — 8/8 pass. H-MEM: tests/test_hmem.py ports the official conformance runner (engines/hmem/conformance/runner.ts) and runs the official vectors file copied unchanged — 13/13 pass. Scout Intent: tests/test_scout.py covers the guard, contract signing/expiry/scope/subject checks and the action path; benchmark security evaluation blocks 15/15 corpus attacks with 0/15 benign false positives and detects 4/4 planted record injections. The official TypeScript runners themselves were not run in the build environment.

zetaris.status: adapter implemented to the documented direct REST SQL route; not yet run against a live Zetaris
zetaris.used_for: federated read of the six source systems, one fixed, validated SELECT per system, with per-system provenance shown in every investigation

nvidia.used_for: Nemotron phrases the explanation and the strongest counterargument; never computes money, status or permissions; output validated against the evidence index
